definitions.gloss: to stand frozen; to be rooted to the spot
definitions.explanation: To stand motionless, unable to move, due to fear, shock, or overwhelming emotion.

examples.japanese: {恐怖|きょうふ}で{立|た}ちすくんだ。
{突然|とつぜん}の{大|おお}きな{音|おと}に{立|た}ちすくんだ。
examples.english: I froze in place at the sudden loud noise.

examples.japanese: {目|め}の{前|まえ}に{熊|くま}が{現|あらわ}れて、{立|た}ちすくむしかなかった。
examples.english: A bear appeared right in front of me, and all I could do was stand frozen.

notes:
{立|た}ちすくむ describes standing motionless, unable to move, typically due to fear, shock, or overwhelming emotion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

WORD FORMATION:
{立|た}つ (to stand) + すくむ (to cower, to stiffen). The verb すくむ means to become rigid or paralyzed.

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}ちすくんでいる means "is standing frozen" — a continuing state of paralysis.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {恐怖|きょうふ}で{立|た}ちすくむ: to freeze with fear
- ショックで{立|た}ちすくむ: to stand frozen in shock
- {圧倒|あっとう}されて{立|た}ちすくむ: to be rooted to the spot in awe

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {足|あし}がすくむ: legs freeze (with fear)
- {身|み}がすくむ: body freezes up
- {動|うご}けなくなる: to become unable to move
